profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have a Bachelor's in Computer Science with a concentration in Cyber Security and a minor in Mathematics at the University of Texas at El Paso. I have also volunteered in the past as a research assistant in my university in the topic of Pair-Wise Testing along my advisor Dr. Martine Ceberio. Next to that, I was president of the student organization ACM-W in UTEP with the hopes of helping women like me advance in their technical careers. While in there, I had the opportunity to start and kick-off a new program in cooperation with Google called IgniteCS with the objective of teaching the basics of Computer Science to middle school students in the El Paso area. In the summer of 2016, I worked in ExxonMobil as an intern where I was able to learn about videoconferencing. On the following year, I had an internship with USAA in the Marketing Apps team where I developed a testing tool in Java. Between January 2018 and August 2018 I had an internship in Leidos where I developed, tested, and debugged a mobile app that interfaces with the ColibriNANO SDR with the objective of optimizing the software to compensate for the processing limitations of mobile phones.

positions.title: ExciTES Summer Computer Science Intern
positions.description: Design and conduct new, fun, and innovative activities in order to introduce Computer Science and Engineering to younger generations. Aid in the daily work activities conducted by the ExciTES team.
